headline: Names a VA clinic in Columbus, Georgia, after Robert S. Poydasheff.
what_it_does: This law renames the Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic in Columbus, Georgia, as the Robert S. Poydasheff VA Clinic. It only changes the clinic's name. It does not change services, funding, or rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on November 12, 2021, and the summary does not give a separate effective date.
